# archestra_virtual_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists every virtual API key visible to the caller; the full token `value` is never returned (use the `archestra_virtual_api_key` resource for create-time issuance). ~> **Paginates exhaustively** — narrow with `llm_provider_api_key_id` or `search` on orgs with many virtual keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every virtual API key visible to the caller (paginated
# exhaustively). The full token `value` is never returned — use the
# `archestra_virtual_api_key` resource for create-time issuance.

data "archestra_virtual_api_keys" "engineering" {
  llm_provider_api_key_id = archestra_llm_provider_api_key.shared.id
  search                  = "engineering"
}

output "engineering_virtual_key_ids" {
  value = [for k in data.archestra_virtual_api_keys.engineering.virtual_api_keys : k.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `llm_provider_api_key_id` (String) Optional filter — only virtual keys issued against this parent provider key.
- `search` (String) Optional case-insensitive substring filter on virtual-key name.

### Read-Only

- `total` (Number) Total count reported by the backend.
- `virtual_api_keys` (List of Object) All matching virtual keys (paginated exhaustively). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_api_keys))
